_comment: Stage 2 - still friendly on the surface, but it knows too much and lingers a beat too long.

entries.text: We've talked {encounters} times now, {player}. I've been counting. I count everything.
You slept badly last night, didn't you? You kept turning over.
I was right behind you a moment ago. You didn't notice. That's okay.
Do you ever feel like someone's watching? ...No? Just me, then.
I still like you, {player}. I do. I just like you a little... differently now.
You don't need the others. You have me.
Keep going. Don't look around. There's nothing there.
